name: simulate-inherited-ira-boundary
why: Measured reach for the grouped annual inherited-IRA distribution planner and shared applicable-plan identity boundary. Six block-O members exercise legacy and classified schedules, S2 pre/post-election and death-year behavior, final sweeps, dead beneficiaries, Roth character, zero-movement sub-cent shortfalls, compatible duplicate physical rows represented by one logical ID, ordered application, applicable-plan aggregation, pre-horizon limitations, and repeated all-four-mode entry. REPINNED on 2026-09-04: publishing the discriminated inherited-IRA refusal code added one line inside each of C2.death-evidence, E.legacy and G.identity-and-execution, so those three measured ranges are one line longer than they were -- the added line is the refusalCode publication itself, in each case beside the refusalReason the range already covered. Every other range in this spec moved positionally only. REPINNED on 2026-09-25 (decision D-INHERITED-ROTH-SLICE): the inherited fold now also sums inheritedTraditionalForced, the forced dollars from inherited traditional accounts, so I.delegate (963-1097, now 965-1106) is seven lines longer: the new accumulator and its three-line comment, and the traditional else branch, now braced around a second statement. Every other range in this spec moved positionally only.

measuredProof.method: The blocks corpus and both engine source trees are materialized from immutable Git objects, then captured in default, cashFlow, optimizerProbe, and counterfactual modes. The verifier authenticates the proof spec and every transitive mutable equivalence input against both HEAD and the path-normalized working tree before execution, then recomputes corpus, captures, structural comparison, reach, and all recorded hashes. The generic comparator must report IDENTICAL and the independent entry walk must find zero moved entries.
measuredProof.scope: Every blocks-corpus member is byte-identical in all four modes. O6 independently calibrates a lone zero-movement inherited Roth residue as a 0.004 applicable-plan shortfall with a 0.001 section 4974 excise; O3 calibrates three such residues sharing one identity as a 0.012 shortfall with a 0.003 excise. Focused helper tests separately pin those cases plus a 0.01 actual distribution followed by a skipped 0.004 remainder, which remains a 0.004 shortfall with a 0.001 excise. Delegation tests pin immutable snapshotting, grouped duplicate identities, ordered single-write application, runtime journaling, evidence and obligation publication, and hostile failure before caller mutation.

harnessRepins.reason: Decision D-CASH-PROPERTY-ALIAS made the plan checks refuse any id two rows would publish a value under, so six blocks members (c8, e5, h1, j4, n1, r1) that shared property, debt or policy ids now give each row its own id. No block-O, block-Q or block-Y member this proof measures changed. The pin is advanced so the harness closure still authenticates at HEAD; the corpus, capture, reach and calibration figures in this record were measured with the earlier blob and were not re-measured. This proof's engine-tree check already ties it to its own head source tree, so it verifies only at that tree.

After main at c2d61967 (plan schema v7, #765) was merged into the D-2027-ROLLOVER branch, two block members no longer parsed under the current tree: j1 (spending phases in a couple) now names phasesAgeOf p1, the person listed first, whose age its phases followed and whom the v7 migration names, and which a tree before v7 drops; and v3 (three qualified contracts) names p1 as each annuitant instead of no owner, the primary the ownerless fallback resolved to. No other member changed. Re-measured by the procedure the D-SS-ANALYSIS-EARNINGS-TEST branch used for the same change: run with the blob this record was measured with (7a1507c9bbf8e42f2e465195628bd389951c8025, the last entry's measuredWithBlob; the blob it pinned, df82d4ee7fbeeaa41c43b1811f05ddb161b01268, was never measured) it reproduces this record's figures exactly, and with this blob only the corpus identity moved: the member hash 1613a1fc1616 to 66cff52e468b and the dump hashes; members stay 121 and entries 484. The comparison is still IDENTICAL with 0 entries moved and the reach counts are unchanged.

historicalRecord.statement: This proof verifies only at its recorded engine trees: head b63271eaed9a0e5cc36db5b525c834b830f5b16d (packages/engine/src at commit 07b3614d4459ae67fa9de31b28c0f09f0b212680) and base d8e8d22f1bd0931f79bca576612b66a60e430987 (packages/engine/src at commit df896740af6ef75e01931720abcbc1074e428570). It has not been verifiable at main's HEAD since later commits changed packages/engine/src, so HEAD no longer carries the recorded head tree the verifier requires, and re-pinned this spec, so the recorded specMeasurementSha256 no longer matches it. It stands as a historical record of that extraction, not as a check the current engine passes.

readingTheCounts: Member counts prove execution and the reach command additionally fails on cold executable whole lines. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every operand sharing a line, so the report must be read with focused helper, hostile delegation, grouped-duplicate integration, and calibrated-mutation tests.
